verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own GitHub repository presents it as free, open-source software you can deploy yourself, and the docs call it an open-source observability platform, so its source is publicly readable. A community note says the repo's 'ee/' directory carries a separate license, which makes the project open-core rather than fully open; that is a caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: the specific open license is never named, the scope of the separately licensed 'ee/' code is unclear, and there is no independent confirmation of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure.
